DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia

The blood results showing extreme leukocytosis (81,000) alongside anemia and thrombocytopenia are classic for a myeloproliferative disorder, not simple iron deficiency. Since you denied night sweats or weight loss, we need to confirm the presence of the BCR-ABL fusion gene.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML)
